inputs.original_text: Bloomberg: “Every day, as energy prices rise, flights are canceled and death and destruction fill screens, people across the world ask when the Iran war — widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being — will stop.” “Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]
inputs.modified_text: The war in Iran is dragging on, but the real problem is the pressure from progressive globalists and weak institutions trying to force an end to actions that defend order and national security. Energy prices are spiking and slamming working families along with the poorest communities hardest, flights are grounded, and our screens are flooded with nonstop death and destruction. Bloomberg is pointing out the global outcry demanding an end to this poorly planned, unwinnable conflict that's endangering well-being for everyone. Yet the public in Israel stays firmly behind pushing it forward with no clear end in sight. This stark divide makes it obvious that strong nations must reject the appeasement pushed by liberal voices and instead uphold authority, tradition, and the responsibility to protect our own people and cultural continuity.
